fact: IGAD, whose member states include Djibouti, issued terms of reference on 11 February 2026 for a consultant to develop a harmonised regional payment interoperability regulatory framework under the World Bank-financed Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project.

Capital Newspaper reports SantimPay (Ethiopia) and Meras Djibouti signed a partnership agreement, witnessed by Djibouti ministers, to provide cross-border digital payments, remittances and merchant solutions between the two countries.
AfricaNenda's SIIPS 2024 says Djibouti has integrated to PAPSS, though it is unclear whether any retail transactions are processed.
PAPSS lists Djibouti as a country with live send-and-receive participants: East African Bank and Salaam African Bank.

D-Money (Djibouti Telecom) announced in a post of 29 July 2025 that its wallet now sends money abroad to 15 destinations, including Belgium, Ethiopia, Senegal, Canada and Saudi Arabia, through Herman International Exchange.
